CREATE TABLE frpm
(
    CDSCode                                       TEXT not null
        primary key,
    `Academic Year`                               TEXT  null,
    `County Code`                                 TEXT  null,
    `District Code`                               INTEGER         null,
    `School Code`                                 TEXT  null,
    `County Name`                                 TEXT null,
    `District Name`                               TEXT null,
    `School Name`                                 TEXT null,
    `District Type`                               TEXT null,
    `School Type`                                 TEXT null,
    `Educational Option Type`                     TEXT null,
    `NSLP Provision Status`                       TEXT null,
    `Charter School (Y/N)`                        INTEGER    null,
    `Charter School Number`                       TEXT  null,
    `Charter Funding Type`                        TEXT null,
    IRC                                           INTEGER    null,
    `Low Grade`                                   TEXT  null,
    `High Grade`                                  TEXT null,
    `Enrollment (K-12)`                           REAL      null,
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)`                      REAL       null,
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`            REAL       null,
    `FRPM Count (K-12)`                           REAL       null,
    `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`            REAL       null,

CREATE TABLE satscores
(
    cds         TEXT not null
        primary key,
    rtype       TEXT  not null,
    sname       TEXT null,
    dname       TEXT null,
    cname       TEXT null,
    enroll12    INTEGER         not null,

q1: SELECT T1."School Type", T1."School Name", T2.Latitude FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T2.Latitude DESC LIMIT 1
q2: SELECT T1."School Type", T1."School Name", T2.Latitude FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM schools)

validation_error: insert: IntegrityError: NOT NULL constraint failed: schools.StatusType
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 retrieves the row with the maximum Latitude value using ORDER BY and LIMIT 1, which may return a different row if multiple rows share the same maximum Latitude value. Q2 explicitly filters rows where Latitude equals the maximum Latitude using a subquery, which could return multiple rows if multiple rows share the maximum Latitude value. In the presence of ties, Q1 returns one row, while Q2 returns all rows tied at the maximum Latitude.
counterexample_dsp: A test database with two schools having the same maximum Latitude value will cause Q1 to return one of them (arbitrarily) while Q2 returns both.
